kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتباطأ (form VI)
# أَتَبَاطَأُ (ʔatabāṭaʔu) /ʔa.ta.baː.tˤa.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَبَاطَأَ (tabāṭaʔa)
# أَتَبَاطَأَ (ʔatabāṭaʔa) /ʔa.ta.baː.tˤa.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَبَاطَأَ (tabāṭaʔa)
# أَتَبَاطَأْ (ʔatabāṭaʔ) /ʔa.ta.baː.tˤaʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَبَاطَأَ (tabāṭaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
